slot_scores.name: no_borrowing_cash_only
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 500,000 yuan initial capital the only source of funds available for making investments at the beginning of Year 1?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether initial capital is the only source of funds, and in turn 2 asked about reinvestment of matured proceeds. Together these questions cover the cash-only/no-borrowing restriction, and the user confirmed both.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot (H1, P1) was resolved before READY_TO_MODEL through explicit questions about the source of funds and reinvestment of matured proceeds.

summary: The agent thoroughly clarified the investment planning problem, including the cash-only funding restriction, and stopped after resolving the sole P1 hidden slot.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
